192: def make_compiled_finite_pullback(reuse_scalar_products=False, *, dynamic_shapes=False, compiler_options=None):
193:     """Use the official compiler to fuse layout/scalar work; keep native FLA calls.
194: 
195:     Compile time and steady cost must be recorded separately. CUDA graphs and
196:     max_autotune are disabled; default compiler kernel tuning can still run and
197:     must be counted. This wrapper does not cache model endpoints or computed
198:     coefficients. Source identity must be verified by its caller.
199:     """
200:     def mixed(endpoints, adjoints, scale):
201:         return mixed_coefficients(endpoints, adjoints, scale, reuse_scalar_products)
202:     compiled = torch.compile(mixed, fullgraph=True, dynamic=None if dynamic_shapes else False,
203:         options={'triton.cudagraphs':False, 'max_autotune':False, **(compiler_options or {})})
204:     def pullback(endpoints, do, scale):
205:         adjoints = native_input_adjoints(endpoints,do,scale)
206:         if dynamic_shapes:
207:             # Time/chunk count and minibatch size vary. The paired endpoint
208:             # layout, head count and head width remain fixed. Batch permits
209:             # the compiler's required singleton specialization for B1 tails.
210:             for name in ('q','k','v','raw_g','g','beta','A','v_new','h'):
211:                 value = endpoints[name]
212:                 if value.shape[0] > 1:
213:                     torch._dynamo.maybe_mark_dynamic(value, 0)
214:                 if value.shape[1] > 1:
215:                     torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(value, 1)
216:             for value in adjoints.values():
217:                 if value.shape[0] > 1:
218:                     torch._dynamo.maybe_mark_dynamic(value, 0)
219:                 if value.shape[1] > 1:
220:                     torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(value, 1)
221:         return compiled(endpoints, adjoints, scale)
